title: Knowledge
description: Review-ready, approval-authorized knowledge unit destined for the local-first Knowledge Plane SoR. See /artifacts/knowledge.md.

title.description: Human-readable title for the knowledge unit.
examples: Retry Backoff Guideline: Jittered Exponential Backoff Defaults

body.description: The Markdown content, authored faithfully from the approved Proposal's citations only.

front_matter.description: Structured metadata (tags, category, audience, etc.) governed by the Markdown Agent's template.

claim_provenance.description: Maps each factual claim to its supporting citation_keys. Under strict policy, every factual claim in body must have an entry here.

citation_keys.description: Must match citation_key values from the referenced Proposal.citations[].

span_hint.description: Locator hint (e.g. heading + ordinal position) for traceability.

proposal_ref.description: Pointer to the sealed Proposal this knowledge was drafted from.

approval_ref.description: Pointer to the HumanReviewDecision that authorized this exact content. outcome must be the literal 'approved'.

examples.title: Retry Backoff Guideline: Jittered Exponential Backoff Defaults
examples.body:
## Guideline

All agent-to-agent retries SHOULD use jittered exponential backoff with a capped ceiling per failure class.
